propositions: The batched-map transient recovery test recovers from a transient Git read on the batched side but the one-shot per-event oracle returns None, causing false-negative equivalence comparison.

Production resolve_event_commit intentionally maps all Git errors, empty results, timeouts, and exceptions to None and must retain fail-closed behavior; repair must be confined to the test fixture only.

The test-local bounded oracle helper must retry the per-event resolver up to five times on transient failures (rc128, rc0/empty, BlockingIOError EAGAIN), returning only non-None SHAs and raising diagnostics on persistent failure.
All batched/per-event exact equivalence assertions in the fixture module must route through the shared bounded oracle helper without weakening exact position-to-SHA expectations.
No production source files in src/rebar must change and resolve_event_commit must retain its documented fail-closed contract.
